title: Marks the renderer carries but does not draw: spiccato, breath, bow direction
description: Three quarter-note C5s with the three event markings that are valid MNX but have no glyph in the engraving yet: spiccato (excluded from the drawn set for want of a glyph in the bundled Bravura subset), a breath mark with the comma symbol, and an up-bow direction. Each is silently dropped — no badge, because a marking the reader would merely miss is a warning-grade gap at most. The goldens pin the bare notes; each mark that lands later moves this golden.
